from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687629/attempts/1a23792c575c414fa559b68921d57662/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c7083943.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h)
             if grid[r][0] != 0 and all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    period = len(marks)
    by_residue = {r % period: color for r, color in marks}
    # The marker rows occupy distinct positions modulo their count.
    # Fill any unseen residue using the marker sequence in vertical order.
    for i, (_, color) in enumerate(marks):
        by_residue.setdefault(i, color)
    return [[by_residue[r % period] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
ns={};exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),ns)
